verdict.rationale: Bento documents capturing LLM calls as traces: OpenTelemetry span capture, SDK-level capture of every LLM call, and manual wrapping via bento.track_ai. Cost per run is surfaced, but the evidence never states which fields each trace records. missing for 10: explicit documentation that traces record prompt inputs, model outputs, per-call latency and token usage, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry.
Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai.
Bento captures every LLM call at the SDK level.
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
